title: Whittaker's Chocolate Block Varieties 200g-250g $7.00 @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: Whittaker's Chocolate Block Varieties 200g-250g $7.00 @ Woolworths

[foogle] Once upon a time these beauties used to be $4.
[Fredfloresjr] Those were the days bro, Machete bins were like $2400 that time and recently gone up to $13M each
[Sebajun] I'm sad I discovered them only when they were $6. I was in NZ recently and they were discounted at nz$6.5 (au$5.4). Brought back 15 lol.
[eggboi] In 2023 or something, Coles ran a deal where they were $5, and you got an extra $2 off if you scanned your flybuys card. Needless to say, I bought 15 blocks and kept them in the fridge. Wish I'd bought more…
[nathanos] @donman92: Gunna need to figure out how to convert freedom units into rest of the world units so we can activate it and go back 30 years.
[foogle] trip down memory lane - $3.60 at Woolies, $4 at Coles https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/642422
[odysseus] So doubled in price in only 5 years. Way above inflation.
[Jasonio] Yeah almost like inflation doesn't exist.
[eggboi] It sure as hell isn’t 200% over 4 years.
[odysseus] Which country are you in with 40% inflation per annum?
[belongsinforums] All chocolate has gone up. Find a better, cheaper chocolate
[Bargain Slut] Honestly the Aldi choceur brand might be better relative to cost for milk chocolate.
[Sebajun] That. When Whittaker got too expensive we started buying at Aldi. Switched from Whittaker's Dark Almond to Choceur Dark Almond. Not as excellent but very good.
[Jackson] @Sebajun: The dark hazelnut is the pick and possibly better than Whittaker's
[Bargain Slut] @Jackson: Yeah dark hazelnut is excellent imo
[slamdunka] Or dont buy it. Price will soon come down
[illusion99] Yes. You’re living in pre 2022 and haven’t caught up to new prices. Do you still think petrol is $1 a litre?
[eggboi] If you think $8 is a reasonable price for something that was $4 3-4y ago, you’re a sucker.
[Jackson] Petrol is 0c/kWh and has been for a while now
[djtranny] Nestle blocks have been $3.50 lately and I'd prefer a block of Nestle over Whittaker's even at the same price!
[goodwillN1] Which one is Nestle? Nestle are a generic company that produces a lot of OK and a lot of sh*t products…
[ihbh] Cheers mate. Still got a stash of the Dark Ghana at the old price, but will be following end of year/early next year. Does you app do alerts?
[StockUpApp] No worries! Yep the app does alerts, you can set them on your favourites and you'll get a push notification when it hits that price.
[Xizor] Crazy how expensive has gotten. Was my go to but a rare treat now.
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Usually I would have a bottle of zacapa xo, or penfolds great grandfather, or JW blue on hand to celebrate a special occasion. Closing on a big project for work, birth of a child, Christmas Day etc…. Maybe now whittakers dark Ghana will take a place among them…
[Headless] Fascinating to know that cocoa prices have dropped significantly, but chocolate is still sold at an all time high and isn't coming back down any time soon.
Profits are currently huge
[Headless] https://markets.ft.com/data/commodities/tearsheet/summary?c=…
Was over twice what it is now when the chocolate rush started
[goodwillN1] @Headless: Correct, it dropped. But if you do some more reading you will find out that these huge bulk producers have contracts covering periods way ahead. That helped them ride out the peak but probably not all the way to this valley so their real cost was somewhere in-between.
[OfficerBarbrady] Ive been eating this chocolate all year. I'm sure its been $7 or cheaper more then once the entire year.
[OnlyHans] [NSW, ACT, VIC, SA] Whittaker's Honey Nougat Almond Block 250g $4.50 + $8/$12 Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ $59/$99 Order) @ BIG W in February
[choory] Last time I ate these were $4…hmm.. 2022 or 2023 I can't remember maybe I need some sugar. Anyway Hazelnut is really good.
[TheCunningLinguist] This is a 'woolworths' bargain ie. Used to be cheaper at normal price
[RecklessMonkeys] A while back a checkout chick mentioned that Caramello Koalas were about to double in price to $2.
So now they market them as 'half price' for $1.
It sums up their 1/2 price BS.
It's totally artificial and worthy of the ACCC's attention.
[RecklessMonkeys] @Jasonio: Tin foil - also half double price. Buy some now - don't miss out.
[illusion99] Not defending Woolworth but there is a global cocoa shortage so all chocolate is more expensive accordingly. It’s like saying petrol used to be normal price therefore oil refineries must be gourging and ignoring factors like the war in Iran. Simplistic argument that price increases is always due to price gouging
[Reggienator] The cocoa price has dropped significantly since it's high last year- from about $13k to $5-6k per tonne.
Funnily enough big chocolate (Lindt etc) have increased profits significantly.
[choory] Always, increase price instantly but drop leisurely or not.
[M00Cow] but there is a global cocoa shortage so all chocolate is more expensive accordingly
That's simply not true.
Have a look at the 1yr & 5yr pricing.
https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/cocoa
Hersey adding more cocoa back in due to significant cocoa price drop
https://www.newsnationnow.com/business/hershey-reeces-to-ret…
TLDR: don't fall for that BS about cocoa prices being too high being the reason chocolate is so high.
[SwampyBits] Where's the goody goody gum drops flavour :(
[StockUpApp] It took almost a year for banana caramel to get here. Will have to find some by other means
[HeyThereJim] For people complaining about the cost consider:
- Cacao prices just keep going up and up. It's likely to only get more expensive due to demand continually outstripping supply and supply being affected by poor growing seasons almost every year these days.
- Cacao has to be shipped to NZ, the finished goods manufactured there, then the retail product is shipped to Aus. The cost of doing all that goes up every year.
You'll be lucky to buy this for $10 next year.
[teereb] Cacao has dropped significantly, well under half what it was last year. https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/cocoa
Don't defend huge business - I still buy whitakers when I want chocolate over most brands. But coles and woolies do, as with all their products, take the piss. Who thought being a monopoly wouldn't be bad for the consumer…
[Phesto] It's $11 at my IGA? Why don't other stores sell it for cheaper?
[tubeidea] Are you being paid by big chocolate to shill on ozbargain?
[dosada] No they don't. It's quite the opposite.. Don't let mainstream media brainwash you
[welcomeUniverseWorld] I got 3 of these delivered from Coles today. Paid extra $6. /facepalm!
[Bearlion] chocolate is expensive everywhere.
woolies sold a brand called Frey. 85% was $2.50 for 100g.
[sedi] This is the only chocolate I spend my money on. Best
[Skitzout] Jelly tip is no more…. move in the the Gum Drop
[Lord Ra] Jelly tip.
Me at the end.
I'll see myself out.

[silverduck22] Prices are back up to 9… I can't even afford chocolate without working overtime, and then I missed the promo anyway… fml
[choory] No, it start from today just not activated yet.(29th ~ 4th)
